description: This file defines the class DefaultEntityId, which implements the EntityId interface. It provides methods for creating, comparing, and generating entity IDs, including a dummy ID, UUID-based IDs, and handling null or empty inputs. It appears to be a core component for identifying entities within the project.

classes.name: DefaultEntityId
classes.description: Immutable implementation of an entity identifier with methods for creation, comparison, and dummy ID handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultEntityId from a CharSequence, returning the argument itself if it is already a DefaultEntityId.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Generates a new DefaultEntityId with a random UUID.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a singleton dummy DefaultEntityId that should not be used normally.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Checks if the current ID is the dummy ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on the ID string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code based on the ID string.
